n: Dual-Technology Occupancy Sensor, PoE, 2,000 Sq Ft (CEN-ODT-C-POE)
d: CEN-ODT-C-POE -Dual-Technology Occupancy Sensor, PoE, 2,000 Sq Ft

specs.label: Motion Detection Technology
specs.value: Passive infrared (PIR) motion detection; Ultrasonic (US) (40 kHz)

specs.label: SETUP
specs.value: (1) Pushbutton located behind the front cover; Press to acknowledge an identify command sent by the host; Press and hold for 7 seconds to reset the device

specs.label: Power over Ethernet
specs.value: IEEE 802.3af PoE Powered Device; 4 W max

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Mounts to a 4 in. (102 mm) octagon box or 3-1/2 in. (88 mm) diameter hole created by provided cutout template; Includes mounting screws and integral toggle clamps; A 2-1/8 in. (54 mm) minimum mounting depth is recommende

specs.label: Depth
specs.value: 3.185 in (81 mm) overall; Projects 0.97 in. (25 mm) from the surface when installed
